In our 3h interactive Git Workshop we will teach you all the Git skills you need for your upcoming project phase.

Git is a tool which allows you to create save points of the current status of your project and return back to it anytime. Git allows you to play around with your code, without being worried to break it!
Even better: This does not only work alone, but also working together with other people! Git (& our used online service GitHub) is designed in a way that multiple people can work on a project at the same time easily.

Lightning Talk #2: Human Rights & Design Thinking

In this talk, two guest speakers from a design consultancy will introduce their Human Rights-Centered Design approach and apply this to the subject of AI.

As Artificial Intelligence evolves, so do the many controversies that surround the use of this advanced technology. It is therefore crucial to understand its impact on a societal and public policy level. Scenarios in problem areas: privacy, explainability, reliability and risks of complex systems, responsibility of professionals for applications and consequences of their work.

The speakers believe that data science and machine learning can help us design intelligent products, services, and systems that improve people’s everyday lives. But in order to have a truly positive impact, AI-powered technologies must be grounded in human rights and work to extend and enhance our capabilities, not replace them.

Lightning Talk #3: Doing what you can't

A guest speaker is a senior software engineer who loves to share knowledge, give talks and help other developers. Throughout his career as a programmer, he had the opportunity to work with large companies and was able to help improve the educational system in Brazil, allowing parents and schools to communicate in real-time. He’s helped over 10 million people share their opinions online, and today at Taxfix he helps thousands of people to control their lives using their money intelligently.

In this talk, he will share part of his story: how he became a developer and left a small town in the countryside to pursue his international career.
